params.body:
## What is wrong

On every push to main the test job ends red although every test passes: after the tests, the coverage of the parallel workers is merged into one report in one PHP process, and that merge dies with "Allowed memory size of 536870912 bytes exhausted".

#929 raised the limit in the workflow (`ini-values: memory_limit=2G`). That never reached the process: `phpunit.xml` sets `memory_limit` to 512M itself, and PHPUnit applies that after php.ini. The run on main after #931 shows it: 2857 tests green, then the same fatal at the same 512M.

## What changes

- `phpunit.xml`: the limit is 2G, with the reason beside it. It is a ceiling, not an allocation; the tests need far less.
- `.github/workflows/tests.yml`: the `ini-values` line that had no effect is removed, so the limit is set in one place.

## Checked

Read from the failed run on main that the limit in force was still 536870912 bytes. Not verified: that 2G is enough for the merge; the first run on main after this merge says so (a pull request does not measure coverage, so this PR's own run cannot show it).
params.title: CI: the coverage merge gets its memory in phpunit.xml, where it is read
